clips.title: The story
paras: Lost Relic Carry involves recovering a fractured piece of an ancient rock-mech automaton and delivering it to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands. The relic's unknown composite material hints at the sophisticated engineering of the Titans, earning serious reverence from dwarven researchers.

Deep within ancient grounds, adventurers can uncover a fractured component of a rock-mech automaton. Far from being simple rubble, its unusual composite material reveals the craftsmanship of an advanced, ancient mechanism tied to the Titans.

Prospector Whelgar, stationed at the Wetlands excavation site, studies remnants of antiquity. Carrying the relic out of danger and delivering it to him provides valuable physical evidence for dwarven scholars probing into their ancient heritage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'
Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there.
Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
